analysis.reason: 4거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 49.2에서 50.0으로 소폭 상승했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있다. MACD 히스토그램은 4980.5997에서 1882.1010으로 개선세가 둔화되며 추세 전환 신호는 미약하다. 5일 평균 거래량 비율 0.97로 거래량 동반 없는 횡보 흐름이 지속되고 있다. 스윙 지지선 240,000원, 저항선 267,000원 사이에서 방향성 탐색 중이다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 4 consecutive sessions. RSI rose slightly from 49.2 to 50.0 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram improvement is slowing, moving from 4980.5997 to 1882.1010, indicating weak trend reversal signals. The 5-day average volume ratio is 0.97, showing continued sideways movement without significant volume. The price is exploring direction between the swing support at 240,000 KRW and resistance at 267,000 KRW.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (260,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (260,300 KRW) / SMA20 (254,075 KRW) / SMA50 (272,875 KRW): Mixed signals with price below short-term SMA5, above mid-term SMA20, and below long-term SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100 (271,000 KRW) / SMA200 (208,276 KRW): Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength above these averages.
· 52-Week Position (62.7%) + Current price level is in the historical middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.2→50.0) + Continued sideways movement in neutral zone + Exploring direction.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (4980.5997→1882.1010) + Slowing improvement diagnosed + Weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band 254,075 KRW) + Bandwidth at 23.66% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (240,000 KRW) + Confirmed support based on Pivot S1 (229,000 KRW) and 5-day low (245,000 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (267,000 KRW) + Breakout could signal a short-term upward trend shift.
· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern (Sideways) + Confirms lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.97x) + Moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + Explicitly stating wait-and-see until directional confirmation.
